derivation: setuptools_scm.get_version(root="/baseline") in the original image with the locked original repository mounted read-only at /baseline; default schemes from the unchanged pyproject.toml.
usage: Both runner build commands explicitly supply this locked version using SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION, the distribution-independent setuptools-scm override. This provisions the git-free unchanged upstream warm-build under its original distribution identity as well as the renamed velunex product build. The override is scoped to the no-deps, no-build-isolation project install, so dependencies do not inherit this version. Re-derive and update both commands and this record whenever the locked revision changes; no fallback version is used.
